scope: Independent exact-byte audit of the single stable efb093d/5a0d/c395 implementation set. No moving R1 repair bytes were inspected and no production data, target, model, weight array, estimator, MC stream, training, or score was opened or run.

exact_runtime_static_replay.qualification: The bound IMPLEMENTATION_STATIC_VERIFICATION_V2R1.json records data_gate/.venv, whose NumPy is 2.4.6. This independent replay proves the frozen source behavior under NumPy 1.26.4 but does not retroactively correct the bound receipt provenance; the R1 static receipt must name the exact interpreter and versions.

manifest_and_freeze_hash_closure.finding: Every source and reference digest named by the stable manifest and implementation freeze matched the exact inspected bytes.

capture_and_source_zero.finding: The adapter observes the one internal native pass of public Estimator.predict, restores hooks, and requires a separately loaded public-parent byte-parity replay. Source-zero is the corrected public parent, not the raw native output.

provider_seams_and_response_indexing.finding: The 15 live provider rows, L1 response start, weight indexing, one fused state, 14 signed transport actions, and off-card-only split recurrences match the frozen V34 algebra. No cross-Gram is introduced.

fit_and_held_role_purity.finding: Fit uses the nine frozen observer_fit state-label rows and excludes rank35 and every observer_selection row. Held MC is model/target blind; the official endpoint target is opened only after the response freeze.

mc_and_statistical_contract.finding: The generator uses two independent 16x500000 streams, float32 propagation, float64 raw block sums, corrected raw-weights-bound seed derivations, independent A/B oracle cross residual, 16+16 two-sample delete-one jackknife, per-stream conventional guards, paired gain, replica ball, and fail-closed mathematical-domain tests. The nonlinear per-block EDG2 statistic is diagnostic only.

fixed_panel_semantics.finding: All four frozen rows must pass individually. Aggregate uncertainty is explicitly conditional MC uncertainty for four fixed contractual cases; population and unseen-network claims are false.

artifact_durability.finding: Canonical JSON/NPZ writers use O_CREAT|O_EXCL, file fsync, read-only chmod, and parent-directory fsync, and reject symlinked parent components.
